_comment: Decisions a settled country may take when it meets their requirements. visible: who sees it (a condition; none: everyone). requires: what must hold to take it, described by requires_text. effects: as events'. once: taken once (default).

decisions.title: Proclaim the union of the Two Lands
decisions.requires_text: Rule nearly all of Upper and Lower Egypt
decisions.text: The sedge and the bee, the white crown and the red: let the ruler be crowned again at Memphis as lord of the Two Lands.

decisions.title: Take the title King of Sumer and Akkad
decisions.requires_text: Rule Babylon, Sippar, Isin and Larsa
decisions.text: Enlil has given the four quarters into our hand: let the scribes write the ancient title of Ur-Nammu and Hammurabi's ancestors on every tablet.

decisions.title: Raise a great monument
decisions.text: A pyramid, a ziggurat, a palace of a thousand rooms: a work that will carry the ruler's name to the end of time, and keep the levies busy between the harvests.

decisions.title: Found a merchant colony abroad
decisions.text: Send our merchants with silver and a charter to set up a trading quarter in a foreign city, with our judges and our gods, and a share of all they sell for the palace.

effects.message: Our merchants have founded a colony abroad: silver, tin and new ideas will flow home.

decisions.title: Reform the calendar
decisions.text: The priests have measured the year against the rising of the stars: the festivals and the tax-days will be fixed anew.

decisions.title: Build a royal road
decisions.text: A road of stone from the capital to the frontier, with way stations and wells: the levies will march in days where they marched in weeks.

decisions.title: Train a chariot corps
decisions.requires_text: Horses in the land, Horse domestication, Bronze working, 120 gold
decisions.text: Buy horses and chariots from the north, and wrights to build more: the king's own chariotry, as the kings of the east have.

decisions.title: Proclaim a general amnesty
decisions.text: Open the prisons, forgive the debts of the poor and the taxes in arrears: the land settles, and the treasury pays.
